Prediction with Stereo / Mono
Playback speed change (0.8 ~ 1.2)
Pitch control (-4 ~ +4)
Loop playback with a specified range

Check out the demonstration video on the developer's website.

*The sound sources that can be read from the Music app are songs purchased from the iTunes Store.
Or only music that is not protected by DRM (Digital Rights Management).
